children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, trim earlier declines as U.K. second-quarter GDP data came in better than expected, raising the prospects of the Bank of England increasing interest rates. Revised data show second-quarter GDP rose by 0.5% compared with the first quarter, stronger than the earlier estimate of 0.4%. The consensus forecast by economists in a WSJ poll was for an unchanged reading. Markets price in an 82% chance of the BOE raising rates in November, and fully price in four rate increases by July 2027, LSEG data show. Ten-year gilt yields are down 1.1 basis points on the day to last trade at 5.386%, having fallen by more than 5 basis points in early trade, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
